pages.title: Music Discs
pages.text: A thin record can unfold the same melody again and again. Let its pattern dissolve in one final echo, and more than silence remains.

pages.title: Putting It to Work
pages.text: Tune the device, then nearby $(l)jukeboxes$(), up to four. Each cycle $(l)permanently consumes one record$(). Select a jukebox again to disconnect it.
